title: Quantum chaos and the holographic principle
summary: Recent years have witnessed tremendous progress in developing a fine-grained low-dimensional holographic correspondence, specifically the construction of quantum mechanical boundary theories as holographic duals of two-dimensional gravity. In these developments, quantum chaos played a crucial role, both as source of universality and as a guiding principle for the matching of bulk and boundary signatures of gravity.
